name: Invoicery
description: Invoicery is a self-hosted boutique workshop for crafting invoices, tracking expenses, managing inventory, and generating automated Indian GST (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B) tax reports. Built with Bun, SQLite, and vanilla modern web tech, featuring offline-first local data ownership, automated interstate/intrastate tax routing, backup & restore, and a clean dark-mode UI.

paths.name: Data Storage Path
paths.description: Persistent directory for storing Invoicery SQLite database (billing.db).

paths.name: Attachments Storage Path
paths.description: Persistent directory for storing invoice PDFs and receipt uploads.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port used by the Invoicery web interface.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Network binding address (set to 0.0.0.0 to allow access from local network).

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: Path to SQLite database file inside container.
